_meta.purpose: Customer-facing source strings from the Tara consultation worker that need high-quality Arabic translation.
_meta.target_arabic_style: Modern Standard Arabic, naturally understood in Saudi and the Gulf. Do not use slang or heavy dialect. Do not use stiff institutional Arabic.
_meta.customer_address: Address the customer in feminine singular where Arabic requires it.
placeholder_rules: Do not translate internal keys or enum values.
These are customer-facing strings, not internal schema labels.

primary_question.text: What's your primary hair or scalp concern?
options: Ageing hair or loss of vitality

voice_retry_copy.question_text: I couldn't hear enough from that voice note. Please type it here instead, or tap one of the suggestions and extend it.
voice_retry_copy.question_context: I do not want to guess and send you down the wrong path from a weak transcript, so typed text is the safest next step.
voice_retry_copy.placeholder: Type your concern here, or tap a suggestion and edit it.
voice_retry_copy.micro_insight: You can start from a suggestion and make it more specific to you.
voice_retry_copy.bridge_text: I did not catch enough to move forward safely, so I want you to type it in your own words.

primary_concern: More shedding than usual, especially at the front.
Oily roots and buildup between washes.
Flakes or itchiness on the scalp.
Hair looks thinner and less dense than before.
More shedding after stress or postpartum.
Hair has lost vitality with age.
loss_pattern: I see mostly full hairs coming from the root.
I see mostly short broken pieces through the front or lengths.
It feels like a mix of shedding and breakage.
I'm not fully sure which one it is yet.
onset_timing: It started suddenly in the last 2 to 3 months.
It has been building gradually for more than 6 months.
It feels somewhere in between those two.
I'm not sure when it really started.
scalp_environment_signals: My roots feel heavy and I get buildup quickly.
I notice itch or visible flakes most often.
My scalp feels tender or reactive.
I do not notice a strong scalp symptom.
